faq_anyone_a: Yes, anyone can use it for free! If you register and log in, the system will directly grant a 30-day Pro trial.
faq_1_q: What is the core difference between Free and Pro?
faq_1_a: Free provides full DNR rule blocking and anti-tracking features. Pro unlocks AI model cloud OTA updates, local on-device AI detection (anti-phishing/anti-mining), and cross-device cloud sync for whitelists.
faq_2_q: What happens after the trial ends? Will I be charged automatically?
faq_2_a: No. You get a 30-day Pro trial upon registration without auto-billing. You must manually subscribe via the pricing page. If you don't, the system automatically downgrades you to Free.
faq_3_q: What payment methods are supported? Is it secure?
faq_3_a: All payments are processed by Stripe. We support Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We never store your credit card info, ensuring 100% payment security.
faq_4_q: Can I get a refund if I'm not satisfied?
faq_4_a: Yes. We offer a 14-day money-back guarantee. If you're not satisfied within 14 days of purchase, contact support for a full refund.
faq_5_q: Will I lose Pro features immediately if I cancel?
faq_5_a: No. Your benefits remain active until the end of your current billing cycle. During this period, you can still enjoy all Pro features. After that, you will be downgraded to Free automatically without any hidden charges.
faq_6_q: Should I choose Pro or Family?
faq_6_a: Pro is for individuals (up to 3 devices like PC + Phone + Tablet). Family is for sharing with up to 9 devices. You can invite family members via email in the Dashboard.
faq_7_q: Do invited family members need to pay?
faq_7_a: No. Sub-accounts share the main account's subscription and expiry date. If the main account cancels or expires, all sub-accounts will also be downgraded to Free.
faq_8_q: Can I leave the family group or change members?
faq_8_a: Absolutely. The main account can remove members or unbind devices anytime in the Dashboard. Removed members immediately downgrade to Free.
faq_9_q: How does the 'Invite friends for 120 days Pro' reward work?
faq_9_a: When a friend registers via your link and completes their first real payment, after a 14-day cooling-off period (anti-fraud), 120 days of Pro will be automatically added to your account.

faq_12_q: Why can't some YouTube ads be blocked?
faq_12_a: DewSecure respects the YouTube creator ecosystem. We do not block creator-revenue ads by default.
faq_13_a: Chrome and Edge on the same PC count as 2 devices. Android + PC count as 2 devices. You can unbind old devices in the Dashboard to free up slots.
faq_14_a: Some sites integrate ads deeply with content (same-origin). Blocking them breaks the layout. We prioritize usability. Also, our AI models update daily to kill new ads.

faq_17_q: Can DewSecure stop websites from stealing my CPU for crypto mining?
faq_17_a: Yes, very effectively. Pro uses on-device AI to detect and block silent mining scripts, saving your CPU and battery.
faq_18_q: Why does the page delay showing 'Pro' after successful payment?
faq_18_a: Because payment confirmation is cross-system. The system waits 2.5 seconds to ensure Stripe Webhook has fully saved the benefits to the database before rendering, ensuring 100% data accuracy.
faq_19_q: What happens to my remaining trial days if I upgrade?
faq_19_a: Remaining trial days are automatically added after the new 365 days (e.g., 20 days left + 1 year = 385 days). You won't lose days or be charged extra.
faq_20_q: Will clicking purchase again or refreshing create double billing?
faq_20_a: Absolutely not. The backend has a strict 'active subscription interception' mechanism. It will block and redirect you to the dashboard, preventing double subscriptions.
faq_21_q: What happens if a Family sub-account buys an independent Pro?
faq_21_a: The system will prompt that you will leave the family group. After payment, you become an independent Pro account, and your device slot in the original family group is freed.
faq_22_q: Will my account be deactivated immediately if I request a refund within 14 days?
faq_22_a: Yes. Upon successful refund, the Webhook immediately downgrades your account to Free and clears remaining days. If you are a family owner, the family group will also be dissolved.
faq_23_q: What happens to my 120-day reward if my invited friend refunds immediately?
faq_23_a: 1. Your 120-day reward is voided; 2. Your successful invite count is automatically reduced by 1.
faq_24_q: What if the reward is already issued after 14 days and the friend then refunds?
faq_24_a: If this happens, days already in your balance pool won't be deducted, but the refunded account will still be downgraded. The 14-day lock is designed to protect your interests.
faq_25_q: Why can't I find the 'Renew' button when my subscription is about to expire?
faq_25_a: Because Stripe auto-renews. On the expiry date, it automatically charges and adds 365 days. The renew button only reappears after you click 'Cancel Subscription' and it expires.
faq_26_q: Why do I still have Pro features after clicking 'Cancel Subscription'?
faq_26_a: Cancellation only stops next year's auto-renewal. Your remaining purchased days are still valid until the expiration date.
faq_27_q: Will clicking 'Manage Subscription' to the Stripe page charge me?
faq_27_a: No. This is Stripe's official self-service portal. You can safely update cards, download invoices, or upgrade to Family with prorated pricing calculated transparently by Stripe.
faq_28_q: What to do if cross-device login says 'Token expired' or the extension won't sync?
faq_28_a: Login sessions typically last 1 hour. The website silently pushes the latest Token to the extension instantly. If it fails, ensure you are logged in on the website and refresh the extension.
faq_29_q: I logged in on the Dashboard, why didn't the browser extension sync?
faq_29_a: This usually happens on Firefox. Due to strict privacy policies, Firefox blocks direct communication between web pages and extensions. Chrome and Edge sync seamlessly. On Firefox, please manually enter your email and log in via OTP inside the extension.
faq_30_q: Why does the extension log me out after half an hour or a break?
faq_30_a: This is due to the underlying security Token validity limit (usually 1 hour). The system has a 'silent refresh' mechanism. As long as you don't actively click 'Log out', it will renew in the background. If disconnects are frequent, check your network or log in again.
faq_31_q: I clicked 'Send Code' repeatedly and got 'Too Frequent' error. What to do?
faq_31_a: This is an anti-spam rate limit. Please wait 60 seconds. If you already received a code, you can directly enter the latest 8-digit code from your email, even if web and extension codes are not interchangeable.
faq_32_q: I logged out of the Dashboard, why didn't my extension log out?
faq_32_a: This is by design. Web and extension login states are independent. Logging out on your work computer shouldn't affect the extension protection on your home computer.
faq_33_q: I have 3 devices bound, why can't I log in on another browser?
faq_33_a: To prevent account theft, Pro is limited to 3 devices, Family to 9. Attempting a 4th device triggers a block. Click 'Go to Dashboard', log in, unbind an old device in the Device Management card, and the extension will auto-claim the slot.
faq_34_q: Why does the extension still show device limit reached after I unbind on the web?
faq_34_a: After unbinding on the web, the extension takes a few seconds to detect it. Chrome and Edge have 'second-level listening'. On Firefox, simply click the extension icon (give it focus) after unbinding, and it will auto-refresh.
faq_35_q: Why does reinstalling the extension show device limit reached?
faq_35_a: This is normal security logic. Every reinstall generates a new 'device fingerprint'. Allowing unlimited reinstalls would nullify the limit. For testing, use 'Reload' instead of 'Remove'. Real users should unbind old devices in the Dashboard.
faq_36_q: What is 'Unknown on Linux' or 'Chrome on Linux' in my device list?
faq_36_a: This is a friendly name generated from your OS and browser core. For privacy, we don't collect specific computer models, only generic names.
faq_37_q: I am a Pro user, why are my protection toggles greyed out?
faq_37_a: This usually means the extension hasn't fetched your latest permissions locally. Click the refresh button in the extension, or reopen the sidebar. As long as the cloud shows Pro, all advanced toggles will unlock.
faq_38_q: Does the device-side AI engine secretly collect my web content?
faq_38_a: Absolutely not. DewSecure's AI model runs locally in your browser's sandbox. All page analysis, feature extraction, and blocking decisions happen locally in milliseconds. No data is uploaded.
faq_39_q: Does DewSecure support Opera and Yandex browsers?
faq_39_a: Yes. We offer cross-browser versions: Chrome/Edge get the premium Side Panel; Opera gets a native sidebar; Yandex downgrades to Popup mode. Download the corresponding version on our homepage.
faq_40_q: If the Family owner refunds, will the sub-accounts be downgraded immediately?
faq_40_a: Yes. Sub-account benefits rely entirely on the owner. If the owner refunds or fails to renew, the Webhook sends a dissolve command, and all sub-accounts downgrade to Free.
faq_41_q: Why is my Notification Center empty?
faq_41_a: The Notification Center records billing changes, device logins, family updates, and system releases. If you just registered or haven't triggered any events, it's empty, meaning everything is normal.
faq_42_q: DewSecure blocked a feature I need. How to whitelist?
faq_42_a: Click the DewSecure extension icon in the top right, and find 'Add current domain to whitelist' at the bottom. Refresh the page, and the site will function normally.
faq_chrome_q: How to install, pin, or uninstall DewSecure on Chrome?
faq_chrome_a:
Installation: Go to the Chrome Web Store, search for DewSecure, click 'Add to Chrome', and confirm 'Add extension' in the popup.
Pin icon: Click the 'Puzzle' icon in the top right corner, find DewSecure in the list, and click the 'Pin' icon next to it. Once pinned, you can view real-time blocking stats with one click.
Uninstall: Right-click the DewSecure icon in the toolbar and select 'Remove from Chrome'; or go to the extension management page and click 'Remove'.
faq_edge_q: How to install, pin, or uninstall DewSecure on Edge?
faq_edge_a:
Installation: Visit the Microsoft Edge Add-ons store, search for DewSecure, click 'Get', and confirm 'Add extension' in the prompt.
Pin icon: Click the 'Puzzle' icon to the right of the address bar, find DewSecure, and click the 'Eye' icon (Show in toolbar) next to it; or right-click the icon and select 'Pin to toolbar'.
Uninstall: Right-click the DewSecure icon in the toolbar and select 'Remove from Microsoft Edge'; or go to the extension management page and click 'Remove'.
faq_firefox_q: How to install, pin, or uninstall DewSecure on Firefox?
faq_firefox_a:
Installation: Open the Firefox Add-ons store (AMO), search for DewSecure, click 'Add to Firefox', and click 'Add' in the permission prompt.
Pin icon: Click the 'Extensions' button (puzzle/gear icon) in the toolbar, find DewSecure, click the gear icon or right-click and select 'Pin to Toolbar'. To unpin, right-click the pinned icon and uncheck 'Pin to Toolbar'.
Uninstall: Go to the 'Add-ons and Themes' manager, click the '...' icon next to DewSecure, and select 'Remove'.
faq_yandex_q: How to install, pin, or uninstall DewSecure on Yandex, Opera, Brave, Vivaldi, Arc, etc.?
faq_yandex_a:
Installation: Since these browsers are compatible with Chrome extensions, you can directly visit the Chrome Web Store to search for and install DewSecure; or search in their respective extension stores.
Pin icon: Click the 'Extensions' icon (or puzzle icon) in the top right corner, find DewSecure, and click the 'Pin' icon to fix it to the toolbar.
Uninstall: Go to the extension management page, find DewSecure, and click 'Remove' or 'Delete'.
